biggest_catch: Payouts are monthly and project-based: rates are stated per project before you start, work availability is inconsistent, and small balances can be held until they exceed payout fees.
catches: Pay is per project, not a fixed hourly wage — rates are stated before you begin and vary by project, country, and complexity.

CrowdGen pays via its Dots payout partner: PayPal, local bank transfer, Airtm, SWIFT, Payoneer, or gift card — fees apply per method (e.g., US ACH free 1x/month, extra payouts $0.20; PayPal free 1x/month).
Appen will hold your payment 'where we know the payment is less than the fees that will be incurred' and pay it in a subsequent month once it exceeds the fee threshold — tiny balances wait.
Most projects require passing an unpaid qualification assessment before any paid work.
Task availability is inconsistent; projects can end suddenly.
Payment timing example on the official page is monthly ('Your total payment for work totals $100 for the month') — this is not same-day or weekly cash.

steps: Create a free CrowdGen account and complete your profile (languages, country, device).
Browse projects and apply; pass each project's qualification assessment (unpaid).
Complete tasks (data annotation, transcription, evaluation, search rating) at the project's stated per-task rate.
Track hours/earnings in the dashboard; choose payout method via Dots (PayPal, bank transfer, Payoneer, Airtm, etc.).
Receive payout on the monthly cycle (US ACH/PayPal free once per month; same-day ACH $0.30, instant RTP $0.45).
timing: Monthly payout cycle via Dots: PayPal, local bank transfer, Airtm, SWIFT, Payoneer, or gift card; US domestic ACH and PayPal free once per month; same-day ACH $0.30 / instant RTP $0.45; balances below fee thresholds are held to a later month.
who_pays: Appen pays you per project through its payout partner Dots — each task or project has a set rate shown before you begin.
who_qualifies: 18+, anywhere in the world (rates and payout methods vary by country). Most projects require passing an unpaid qualification assessment plus ID verification. Joining is free — CrowdGen states it will never ask you to pay.
work_available: Inconsistent — projects open and close irregularly and can end suddenly, so this is occasional project work, not a steady stream.
what_gets_accepted: Rates are stated before you begin and pay is per completed task that meets the project's quality bar. Failing a project's qualification assessment means no access to that project at all.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: qualification assessments and guideline study for each project, plus gaps between projects. Small balances can be held to a later month when they don't cover the payout fees.
when_cash_arrives: Monthly payouts via Dots: PayPal, local bank transfer, Airtm, SWIFT, Payoneer, or gift card. In the US, ACH and PayPal withdrawals are free once a month (same-day ACH $0.30, instant RTP $0.45 after that).

repeatable.cadence: New crowd tasks post regularly — complete tasks through the month, get paid in the monthly payout cycle, and keep going.
